cases.name: Kathleen Marie "Kathy" Williamson Simpkins
cases.about: On Facebook, her daughter Christi lovingly remembered her mom, writing "She is the best mom ever! So may have said we look just like mom and I am thankful for that. I am also thankful that she raised me to be independent, strong willed, stand up for myself and to not take shit from anyone! 💜 you so much mom!"
